case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and your kind words. We value our cooperation and the quality your foundry team delivers.

We understand that metalworkers' wages have risen and take that seriously. Having reviewed the full picture, however, we cannot accept the increase as proposed.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

All three options offer a longer contract term, giving you planning security for your workforce. Option C keeps your current payment terms unchanged.

We look forward to your view on which option suits you best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal of a 24-month contract, as it indeed provides valuable planning security for our dedicated workforce. However, we cannot accommodate the prices you suggested, as they do not cover the substantial wage increases we have absorbed. 

Our offer stands at a price of €51.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to speak with our long-standing partners. We have reviewed your latest options and noted that you have shifted the effective date to April 2027, which we cannot accommodate as our wage increases must be covered from December.

Building on your Option C, we must insist on the 1 December 2026 start date, but to keep our dialogue moving, we are prepared to reduce our price to €49.90. This alternative package offers a price of €49.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This brings us very close to our absolute limit, and we trust this fair compromise will allow us to conclude our negotiations successfully.

Otherwise, our final offer (letztes Angebot) stands at a price of €50.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please decide. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Your latest price is still more than we can accept, but we have moved again ourselves. Every option keeps the longer contract term that gives your foundry planning security, and Option C keeps the payment terms you asked for:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 48.61; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-04-01.

Option C: unit price EUR 48.22; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-04-01.

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to speak with our long-standing partners. We have reviewed your latest options and noted that you have shifted the effective date to April 2027, which we cannot accommodate as our wage increases must be covered from December.

Building on your Option C, we must insist on the 1 December 2026 start date, but to keep our dialogue moving, we are prepared to reduce our price to €49.90. This alternative package offers a price of €49.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This brings us very close to our absolute limit, and we trust this fair compromise will allow us to conclude our negotiations successfully.

Otherwise, our final offer (letztes Angebot) stands at a price of €50.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please decide. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
